title: No Entry Desert Mirage
description: A surreal desert landscape features a woman with long flowing red hair adorned with ornate golden and floral patterns emerging from the sand dunes on the left. A weathered wooden sign reading 'NO ENTRY' stands in the foreground while a massive red sun with a black bar across it dominates the purple and orange sky above distant mountains.
prompt: Surreal desert scene at dusk with rolling red sand dunes and distant purple mountains. A beautiful woman with long flowing red hair and ornate golden floral patterns growing from her shoulders and hair emerges from the left side of the frame with her eyes closed. In the center foreground stands a weathered wooden sign on a post that reads 'NO ENTRY' in black capital letters. A giant glowing red sun with a thick black horizontal bar across its center fills the sky, creating an ominous and dreamlike atmosphere.
